name: draft-review-kit
description: A focused kit of feedback-first writing review skills for stress-testing drafts, arguments, pacing, clarity, and line-level prose.

interface.longDescription: Draft Review Kit is a compact set of writing-review skills for stress-testing drafts. It includes developmental editing, hostile reads, general-reader checks, clarity checks, craft lenses, panel/debate review, and line editing.
defaultPrompt: Run a developmental edit on this draft.
Give this the least charitable read.
Convene a panel of reviewers for this piece.
